_meta.format: Every player-facing text value is an array of pages; each page fits 2 lines of 40 chars after word wrap ('\n' forces a break). Map spots are keyed maps.<map_id>.<spot_id>. Each spot has 'lines': an ordered list, most specific first, ending with id 'default' (flags [] and no 'when'). The engine shows the FIRST line whose 'flags' are all set (AND) and whose optional 'when' matches. 'pages' is kept as a mirror of the default line for older readers. battle_lost / battle_won / after / after_heal etc. are unchanged. Props: kind 'prop' (inspect) or 'trigger' (tile trigger); x,y = the cell the player faces, stand = where the player stands. Props/triggers: geometry (kind, x, y, stand, face, tile, trigger_when, opens, counter, states...) is copied from the map's interact_spots, which is the source of truth. Lines with no map spot live in top-level sections: company_inbox, ron_nicknames, ron_battle_openers, vane, catalogue, comfort, unplaced_npcs, signs_awaiting_world_id. 'soul_item' = SOUL_PLAYBOOK item number (15:E# = easter egg). 'pending_story_call': true = neutral until Story Bot/Gary decide. 'story_ruling' = line follows a ruling in design/STORY_RULINGS_SOUL.md.
